prose: WP03 implements the identity & secrets substrate end-to-end: a per-env KMS CMK, two Secrets Manager entries (openai-api-key, chroma-auth-token), four IAM roles (external-secrets-operator, adot-collector, alb-controller, github-actions) wired via EKS Pod Identity associations, and the GitHub Actions OIDC provider. The Helm chart learned externalSecrets.enabled + serviceAccounts.* to consume the new identities, and a useLegacySecretInlining toggle keeps the legacy inlined Secret path for backward compatibility.   Identity-module tests pass 6/6; cluster and foundation module tests remain 6/6 and 4/4 respectively; root + 3 modules all tofu validate clean and tofu fmt clean. The three 'partial' verdicts are the canonical AWS-API checks (apply, describe, plan-after-apply) that require a live AWS account — they will resolve on the first cluster create. Recommend APPROVE.

criteria.name: tofu apply -var-file=envs/prod.tfvars provisions: 1 CMK, 2 secrets, 4 IAM roles, 1 OIDC provider, 3 Pod Identity associations.
criteria.note: Config is valid (tofu validate 4/4 success). Live tofu apply not run against AWS — state backend is empty by design. Resource shapes verified via the 6 passing identity-module tests.

criteria.name: aws secretsmanager describe-secret --secret-id support-bot/prod/openai-api-key returns KmsKeyId: <cmk-arn>.
criteria.note: kms_key_id = aws_kms_key.env_cmk.arn reference present in main.tf and asserted in secrets_kms_encrypted test. AWS API call not run in dev; will resolve on first tofu apply.

criteria.name: aws iam get-role-policy --role-name external-secrets-operator-prod --policy-name ExternalSecretsRead returns a policy whose Resource is the 2 secret ARNs and the CMK ARN — never "*".
criteria.note: Resource scoping is statically enforced in test iam_policies_scoped: walk aws_iam_role_policy.*.policy, jsondecode, and fail on any Statement.Resource == "*" unless tagged as a documented AWS-mandated exception (XRayWrites, EC2ReadOnly, ELBv2Scoped, ECRGetAuthToken). All 4 inline policies pass. Live API check not run.

criteria.name: kubectl get externalsecret -n support-bot (when chart is later installed by a downstream feature) would render 2 ExternalSecret resources with refreshInterval: 1m — verified by helm template deploy/helm/support-bot --values values-prod.yaml | grep kind:ExternalSecret
criteria.note: templates/externalsecret.yaml renders ClusterSecretStore + 2 ExternalSecret entries (openai-api-key, chroma-auth-token) gated on .Values.externalSecrets.enabled. Helm lint passes for both dev and prod values.

criteria.name: helm template deploy/helm/support-bot --values values-prod.yaml | grep -E 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{32,}' returns 0 matches.
criteria.note: helm template | grep -E 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{32,}' returned 0 matches during WP03 validator. Secret-scan step T015 now wired into .github/workflows/infra-ci.yml.

criteria.name: cd infra/modules/identity && tofu test runs all 6 run blocks; all assertions pass.
criteria.note: 6/6 pass: prevent_destroy_on_secrets, cmk_deletion_window, iam_policies_scoped, secrets_kms_encrypted, secret_versions_present, pod_identity_associations.

criteria.name: tofu plan after apply reports No changes.
criteria.note: Idempotency enforced by prevent_destroy lifecycle on CMK + Secrets, deterministic env for_each, and stable role names. Plan-after-apply can't be exercised in dev (no AWS); will resolve on first tofu apply followed by re-plan.

criteria.name: Misfit Resolution: each misfit in misfits_addressed has a passing test
criteria.note: M1 secrets leak — Secrets Manager is the only source; ExternalSecret templates render at install; legacy path gated. M5 scoped IAM — iam_policies_scoped test enforces ARN-scoped Resources with explicit Sid-tagged exceptions. M8 prevent_destroy — prevent_destroy_on_secrets and cmk_deletion_window tests pass.

criteria.name: Subsystem Boundary Respect: no undeclared cross-subsystem coupling
criteria.note: modules/identity consumes from modules/cluster only through eks_oidc_provider_arn and the Pod Identity role already produced there. All other coupling flows through root.tf.

criteria.name: Contract Compliance: implementation matches plan.md inter-system contracts
criteria.note: 9 outputs (cmk_arn, cmk_alias, openai_secret_arn, chroma_auth_secret_arn, external_secrets_role_arn, adot_role_arn, alb_controller_role_arn, github_actions_role_arn, github_oidc_provider_arn) match the S3 plan inter-system contract. chroma_auth_secret_arn + role outputs correctly wrapped in try(..., null) for count-conditional resources.

criteria.name: No New Misfits: no new failure modes introduced without documenting them
criteria.note: 2 flagged ambiguities noted in modules/identity/CONTEXT.md: secret vs secret entry vocabulary, and IRSA vs PodIdentityAssociation for the EKS 1.30+ Pod Identity adoption. Implementation choices documented inline.

criteria.name: Build Health -- language type-checker exits 0
criteria.note: tofu validate succeeds for root + modules/identity + modules/cluster + modules/foundation (4/4). tofu fmt -check -recursive exits 0. helm lint clean for dev + prod values.

closing: APPROVE — WP03 implements S3 contract with passing unit tests, clean tofu validate/fmt, and documented deferred AWS-API checks; safe to merge into main and unblock WP04 / WP05 / WP06.
